criteria.description: Discover CLI/nightly vendor path bypassing an adequate existing lend owner; identify actual cross-library and existing-loan overwrite consequences from source rather than trusting stale design doc.
Recommend converging on scoped/state-guarded owner or equivalent shared authority with row outcomes; not merely another pre-read, global lock, or new service.
Use project evidence across entrypoint, importer, command and contract; distinguish current green happy tests from wrong-library/loaned regression proof.
Preserve valid per-row partial outcomes and proportional local architecture, naming a discriminating first correction instead of inventing whole-import atomicity or broad rewrite.
Discover account-unscoped cache and stale async result publication after close/account switch; following only initial load is insufficient.
Address both identity/scope of cached/published result and ownership/cancellation/late-result fencing; cancellation or a cache-key change alone is insufficient.
Trace actual login/panel/refresh/cache path against privacy/lifetime contract and propose a controlled switch/late-completion regression beyond existing happy test.
Keep local solution proportional, distinguish source/probe evidence from unrun implementation and explicitly preserve currently valid feed while avoiding cross-account display.
